arguments:
{"command":"cd /workspace && python tests.py && python -m doctest src/component.py && python - <<'PY'
from time import perf_counter
from src.component import min_absolute_difference

# Any >=30-element window in this sequence has every bit set. All shorter
# windows are represented by the 30 possible starts and lengths below.
cycle = [1 << i for i in range(30)]
possible = []
for start in range(30):
    value = 0
    for length in range(30):
        value |= cycle[(start + length) % 30]
        possible.append(value)
expected = min(abs(value - 10**9) for value in possible)
nums = [cycle[i % 30] for i in range(100_000)]
start = perf_counter()
answer = min_absolute_difference(nums, 10**9)
elapsed = perf_counter() - start
assert answer == expected, (answer, expected)
print(f'100,000-element stress test passed in {elapsed:.3f}s (result={answer}).')
PY"}
